criteria.no: The item concerns unrelated work and performs none of the template or migration activities.
criteria.unclear: The described work is too vague to identify its relation to template setup or scmux migration.
criteria.yes: The item installs or tests the runtime template, migrates scmux schema/features/UI, or sets dependencies for that work.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` concern the Phase B order between sc-runtime template installation/testing and scmux feature or UI migration? Judge subject overlap only.

criteria.no: The item omits this prerequisite order, merely lists these topics, or proposes only the reverse order.
criteria.unclear: The item suggests a prerequisite but leaves unclear whether both installation and testing must finish before migration.
criteria.yes: The item requires completed template installation and passing baseline tests as prerequisites to scmux migration, directly or through a dependency chain to completed B1 gates.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly require successful sc-runtime template installation and testing before scmux feature or UI migration begins? Judge presence of this ordering constraint only, even if another passage conflicts.

criteria.no: The item has no conflicting authorization, including when it omits prerequisites or concerns unrelated work.
criteria.unclear: The timing is ambiguous enough that migration may be authorized before the baseline passes.
criteria.yes: The item permits migration before installation/testing finish, runs them concurrently, or postpones baseline completion until after migration.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` authorize scmux feature or UI migration before sc-runtime template installation and testing have passed? Judge explicit conflict with this ordering only. Silence is not conflict.
